play.title: SMALL CARDS.
play.intro: Five cards each. Five rounds. One winner. Ready?

steps.title: Get your five
steps.text: Each player starts with 5 cards. Keep them in your hand, ready for battle.

steps.title: Pick. Reveal. Compare.
steps.text: Play 5 rounds in this order: Speed, Power, Jump, Brains, then Total. Each round, choose a card and reveal it together.

steps.title: Highest stat takes the cards
steps.text: Compare the round’s stat. The highest value wins both cards. A tie? The higher Total wins.

steps.title: Count your stars
steps.text: After 5 rounds, count your cards. The player with the most cards wins!

play.demoHint: Tap a stat. See who takes the cards.
play.rulesText: Choose your card before seeing your opponent’s. A round winner takes the revealed cards. If both the chosen stat and Total are tied, agree a house rule before you start.
